trap.label: fazer negociações
trap.wrong: They did talks in Geneva last week.
trap.right: They held talks in Geneva last week.
trap.why: Em português “fazer negociações/uma reunião” leva o aluno a usar do ou make. Em inglês, a colocação é hold talks/a meeting.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com held: “They did a meeting in Geneva.”
rewrite.answer: They held a meeting in Geneva.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com hold out for: “They wait for a better deal.” (They hold…)
rewrite.answer: They hold out for a better deal.
